claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Feral Senses is a permanent always-on trait with no activation event, no use count, and no rest reset cadence. The only current ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which structurally requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. Forcing this unit into 'activation' with fabricated resource fields would be dishonest — there is no action, no quota consumed, no charge that tracks uses, and no rest that refills anything. A new family (e.g., 'passive_grant') is needed for class features that take effect permanently at the level they are acquired.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your connection to the forces of nature grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense variant in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive_grant family existed, ClassFeatureEffect only offers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. Blindsight is a special sense — the v4 atom inventory already contains grant_sense (Effect Atoms section), but it is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union type in types.ts. A new variant is needed: { kind: 'grant_sense'; sense: 'blindsight' | 'darkvision' | 'tremorsense' | 'truesight'; rangeFeet: number }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet
